name: blockify-agentic-data-optimization
description: Blockify: Agentic data optimization for enterprise RAG and agentic search. Blockify replaces naive chunking with deduplicated IdeaBlocks — ≈78X accuracy aggregate improvement, 2.29X vector search accuracy, 40X compression, 3.09X token efficiency. Integrates with LlamaIndex, LangChain, Obsidian, Milvus, Elastic, Supabase, Cloudflare.
